labelling_method: Relevance criteria were written by reading the stored document text of the demo collection and choosing, for each query, exact phrases that state the information needed to assess the claim. A passage is relevant if it comes from the named file and contains the phrase. Criteria were written before running the retriever on these queries, and do not depend on passage IDs or chunking. Negative queries were checked by text search to confirm the collection contains no passage addressing them.
labelled_by: Claude (AI coding assistant) during Milestone 2 development; single annotator
review_status: not yet independently reviewed by a human - spot-check recommended
